query:
DELETE
            FROM auth_rebac_relations
            WHERE (subject_entity_type,
                   subject_entity_id,
                   object_entity_type,
                   object_entity_id) IN (SELECT value ->> 'subject_entity_type',
                                                value ->> 'subject_entity_id',
                                                value ->> 'object_entity_type',
                                                value ->> 'object_entity_id'
                                         FROM json_each($1))
